notes: Canonical engine capability declarations, not a claim that every tool/version is verified. CLI consumes this file; server integration is future work. See docs/git-compat/review-fixes.md for tested scope.

features.title: SHA-256 object format
features.detail: extensions.objectFormat=sha256, 32-byte object ids.

features.title: SHA-1 repositories
features.detail: Gent stores only SHA-256 objects.
features.remedy: Convert the repository with a SHA-256 capable Git, or create a new Gent repository and re-import.

features.title: .git file pointing at .gent
features.detail: Gent-created repositories carry a .git gitfile; discovery follows it.

features.title: Conventional .git directory
features.detail: Repositories created by ordinary Git clone are opened directly.

features.title: Bare repositories
features.detail: core.bare=true; worktree operations refuse.

features.title: Linked worktrees
features.detail: commondir, gitdir and per-worktree HEAD/index are honoured.

features.title: files-based refs
features.detail: Loose refs plus packed-refs with peeled tags.

features.title: reftable ref backend
features.detail: extensions.refStorage=reftable is not implemented.
features.remedy: Set the repository's ref backend to 'files'.

features.title: Loose objects
features.detail: zlib-compressed canonical framing.

features.title: Packfiles (read v2/v3, write v2 full objects)
features.detail: OFS_DELTA and REF_DELTA are decoded; Gent emits undeltified packs.

features.title: objects/info/alternates
features.detail: Borrowed object stores are not searched.
features.remedy: Run 'git repack -a' in the borrowing repository first.

features.title: Index version 2
features.detail: Read and write.

features.title: Index version 3
features.detail: Read only; rewritten as v2 when no v3-only flag is set.

features.title: Index version 4
features.detail: Read only (path prefix compression); rewritten as v2.

features.title: Split index
features.detail: The 'link' extension is required and unimplemented.

features.title: Sparse index / sparse checkout
features.detail: 'sdir' entries and cone-mode sparsity are unimplemented.

features.title: Conflict stages 1/2/3
features.detail: Read and written for merge conflicts.

features.title: Symlinks
features.detail: Mode 120000; link target bytes are the blob. On filesystems without symlink support the operation refuses.

features.title: Executable bit
features.detail: Mode 100755, honouring core.fileMode.

features.title: Arbitrary binary content
features.detail: No text decoding on any storage path.

features.title: Submodule gitlinks
features.detail: Gitlinks can be parsed and transported as object entries. Worktree mutation involving submodules refuses.
features.remedy: Use an external Git for recursive submodule work.

features.title: text/eol/crlf attributes
features.detail: text, -text, eol=lf, eol=crlf, core.autocrlf and core.eol.

features.title: clean/smudge filters and Git LFS
features.detail: Any path matching a filter= attribute refuses before writing.
features.remedy: Check the path out with Git, or unset the filter attribute.

features.title: .gitignore / info/exclude / core.excludesFile
features.detail: Full pattern syntax including negation, directory-only and ** patterns.

features.title: Lightweight tags
features.detail: refs/tags/* pointing at any object.

features.title: Annotated tags
features.detail: Tag objects, peeled in packed-refs.

features.title: Signed commits and tags
features.detail: gpgsig and other extension headers are byte-preserved. Signatures are not verified and Gent does not create them.

features.title: Smart HTTP protocol v0
features.detail: Not implemented yet. Canonical remote commands refuse until the server and transport phases are complete.

features.title: Smart HTTP protocol v2
features.detail: Not implemented. No fallback advertisement is currently served.

features.title: SSH transport
features.detail: Only HTTPS is served.

features.title: Shallow and partial clone
features.detail: deepen, deepen-since, deepen-not and filter are not advertised or accepted.

features.title: Operating during an external rebase/cherry-pick
features.detail: rebase-merge/, rebase-apply/, CHERRY_PICK_HEAD, REVERT_HEAD or BISECT_LOG present.
features.remedy: Finish or abort the in-progress Git operation first.
